rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice, especially for a rural place or village area rather than a city.

example.english: I often went back to the countryside to visit my grandmother when I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個成日返鄉下探婆婆。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 faan1 hoeng1 haa6 taam3 po4 po2

rows.note: Use this for countryside or open areas outside the built-up city, especially when talking about going there.

example.english: We went to the countryside for a walk and some fresh air at the weekend.
example.traditional: 周末我哋去郊外行吓，透吓氣。
example.jyutping: zau1 mut6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 haang4 haa5 tau3 haa5 hei3

rows.note: Use this for a neutral geographic or administrative reference to rural areas, including the rural part of a larger region.

example.english: This plan covers Hong Kong's countryside.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃涵蓋全港嘅鄉郊地區。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 haam4 goi3 cyun4 gong2 ge3 hoeng1 gaau1 dei6 keoi1
